content.title: BREAKING: US Rescues 2nd Missing Crew Member After Recovering Pilot, Rescue Ops Continue | Iran War
content.text: BREAKING: US Rescues 2nd Missing Crew Member After Recovering Pilot, Rescue Ops Continue | Iran War In a massive development in the ongoing US-Iran conflict, the United States has successfully rescued the second missing crew member of the downed F-15E Strike Eagle fighter jet.
